name: token-saver
description: Cut AI coding token waste without hiding the evidence that keeps answers correct.

interface.shortDescription: Save AI tokens without losing critical context.
interface.longDescription: Give coding agents a budget brain: skip overhead on simple tasks, compress large repositories, documents, and logs, preserve full evidence for sensitive debugging, and report auditable token savings.
defaultPrompt: Use $token-saver to choose the smallest useful context workflow for this task.
Use $token-audit to find avoidable context costs.
Use $errors-only to run tests without dumping logs.
Use $full-fidelity when this review must not omit unique evidence.
